name: weekly-certification-en
title: Weekly Benefits Certification — English
description: Every word the form shows, in English, keyed the way the Definition names things: `<itemKey>.label`, `.hint`, `.requiredMessage`, `.constraintMessage`; option labels under `$optionSet.<set>.<value>` and `<itemKey>.options.<value>`; repeat strings (`jobs.addLabel`, `jobs.rowLabel` with `{{@index}}`; `employersOnRecord.rowLabel` is an authored empty string, which means those rows carry no heading); the renderer's own chrome under `$ui.*` and the submit button under `$action.submit.label`. `formats.date` gives the `medium` and `full` date styles the shape the screens show (`03/23/2025`, `Sunday, 03/23/2025`) while the Definition only ever says `formatDate(..., 'medium')` — the Locale, not the form, owns how a date is written.

strings.ableAndAvailable.requiredMessage: Whether you were able and available for work is required.
strings.notAvailableReason.requiredMessage: You must explain why you were not able and available for work, and provide dates.
strings.seekingWork.requiredMessage: Whether you are actively seeking work is required.
strings.notSeekingReason.requiredMessage: You must explain why you were not actively seeking work.
strings.refusedWork.requiredMessage: Whether you refused any work is required.
strings.refusalReason.requiredMessage: You must explain the work offer and your reason for refusal.
strings.inSchool.requiredMessage: Whether you attended school or training is required.
strings.progressSatisfactory.requiredMessage: Whether your attendance and progress were satisfactory is required.
strings.progressReason.requiredMessage: You must explain why your attendance or progress was unsatisfactory.
strings.holidayPay.requiredMessage: Whether you received holiday or vacation pay is required.
strings.holidayPayAmount.requiredMessage: You must enter in the gross amount of holiday or vacation pay before deductions you received.
strings.returningToPayer.requiredMessage: Whether you anticipate returning to this employer is required.
strings.expectedReturnDate.requiredMessage: You must enter in an expected return to work date.
strings.receivedRetirement.requiredMessage: Whether you have received money from a retirement account or pension from {{$payerName}} is required.
strings.amountChanged.requiredMessage: Whether there have been any changes in the amount you’re receiving from {{$payerName}} is required.
strings.workedThisWeek.requiredMessage: Whether you worked during this period is required.
strings.rtwCorrect.requiredMessage: You must indicate if the Return to Work date is correct.
strings.returnedAtAll.requiredMessage: You must indicate if you have returned to work at all.
strings.correctedRtwDate.requiredMessage: You must enter a correct Return to Work date.
strings.rtwHours.requiredMessage: Enter 0 if you have not worked any hours.
strings.rtwGrossEarnings.requiredMessage: You must enter the total amount earned (or expected to be paid), including tips, but excluding any deductions, from this employer.
strings.hours.requiredMessage: Enter 0 if you have not worked any hours.
strings.grossEarnings.requiredMessage: You must enter the total amount earned (or expected to be paid), including tips, but excluding any deductions, from this employer.
strings.workedAllHours.requiredMessage: Whether you worked all hours offered is required.
strings.whyNotAllHours.requiredMessage: You must explain why you didn’t work all hours offered.
strings.workType.requiredMessage: You must select a type of work.
strings.certified.requiredMessage: You must confirm that all answers are accurate to submit your certification.
strings.employerName.requiredMessage: You must enter the employer’s name.
strings.street.requiredMessage: You must enter the employer’s street address.
strings.zip.requiredMessage: You must enter a ZIP code.
strings.minutes.requiredMessage: Enter 0 if you have not worked any minutes.
strings.rtwMinutes.requiredMessage: Enter 0 if you have not worked any minutes.
strings.$action.submit.label: Submit Certification
strings.ldwCorrect.requiredMessage: You must indicate if the Last day of Work date is correct.
strings.correctedLdwDate.requiredMessage: You must enter a correct Last day of Work date.
strings.ldwHours.requiredMessage: Enter 0 if you have not worked any hours.
strings.ldwMinutes.requiredMessage: Enter 0 if you have not worked any minutes.
strings.ldwGrossEarnings.requiredMessage: You must enter the total amount earned (or expected to be paid), including tips, but excluding any deductions, from this employer.
